import numpy as np
# Calculate DTG from Weight (Column C) and Temperature (Column B)
dtg = np.gradient(y1, x)
# Find max DTG peak in 450-800 C range
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
if not np.any(mask):
    marks.append({'type': 'text', 'x': 500, 'y': y1[0], 'text': 'No peak found'})
else:
    # Indices relative to the full array for correct interpolation later
    idx_full = np.where(mask)[0]
    dtg_subset = dtg[idx_full]
    max_idx_local = np.argmax(dtg_subset)
    max_idx_global = idx_full[max_idx_local]
    
    x_peak = x[max_idx_global]
    y_peak = y1[max_idx_global]
    
    # Tangent slope at peak (use derivative value calculated above)
    # Note: np.gradient uses central differences. The value dtg[max_idx_global] is the slope.
    slope = dtg[max_idx_global]
    
    if abs(slope) < 1e-9:
        marks.append({'type': 'text', 'x': x_peak, 'y': y_peak, 'text': 'Slope too small'})
    else:
        # Baseline: Horizontal line at weight at 500 C
        y_base = np.interp(500, x, y1)
        
        # Extrapolated Onset Calculation:
        # Line equation of tangent: Y - y_peak = slope * (X - x_peak)
        # Intersection with baseline Y = y_base:
        # y_base - y_peak = slope * (x_onset - x_peak)
        # x_onset = x_peak + (y_base - y_peak) / slope
        
        x_onset = x_peak + (y_base - y_peak) / slope
        
        # Draw Vertical Line at Onset
        marks.append({"type": "vline", "x": float(x_onset), "text": f"Onset: {x_onset:.1f} °C"})
